summary: This is a basic Java program that prints the text "Hello, World" to the console. It's the simplest possible Java application—just a main method that runs when you execute the program.

explanations.1: A class is a blueprint for creating objects in Java. Every Java program must have at least one class, and the code we want to run goes inside it.
explanations.2: The main method is Java's entry point—it's the first method the computer looks for and runs when you execute a program. It must always be written exactly this way (public static void main(String[] args)) for the program to start.
explanations.3: System.out.println() sends text to the console (your terminal or output window). The text in quotes is what gets printed, and println adds a line break at the end.
